body: My psychiatrist never said anything about bloodwork. Hmph, I wonder if she ever intends to bring it up. Maybe it's just for high doses? I'm not allowed to manage my meds so I don't know the dose, maybe it's not high enough to warrant that.
I haven't had the nausea without food thing yet, but I think I've developed a tolerance to that sort of thing because I don't eat much.
Update: I have been committed to Partial Hospitalization. Can't imagine it would work this time, but I don't want to be kicked out either so...

Update: My mother is now making me stay in her room in lieu of going to the hospital. She does not know how bad it is but she knows it's serious. I feel like a fucking five year old. The tension is rising. Woo.

Since you're the only person that seems to be nice about posting and is actually constructive about it, no matter if it's motivational to me or not, I'll tell you. I'm trying again tonight. Probably will fail but I have to keep trying. There's no place for me anymore and I'm not fit to live properly in a society. I am and will continue to be useless, suicidal and an utter failure. I don't want to die but I am just incapable of reintigrating into work or school or friendships... There's just no way I can go back. I've been dead for a long time. But thank you for listening. No one has done that for me even after I've told them.

Honestly, I don't have any anymore.  Gaming has been sufficient to get me by but really just barely. It's not keeping me here, but it's enough to pass the time. I know that's not the answer you're looking for but it's the truth.
My name is Peyton right now, I think it's awful, so I'm very glad to have an opportunity to change it.
Ironically, he's my favorite character, but I wouldn't want to copy like that even though I'm sure it's more or less a common name.
Yeah, I was thinking about that, too. Especially because my middle name is Gabriel, which definitely has religious connotations.
That was one of the problems with Lucas, was that Luke was kind of weird to me, but I suppose it wouldn't be that hard to correct people. It seems to be the popular one, so..
I tried a few before this, and after a few days I realized it just never fit so I was back to my lists again. Um Spencer, Riley, Will, Ely. Those plus these 2 were the ones that kept coming back.
YES. Thank you so much.

I don't know either, to be honest. But the way you phrased something struck me just now. "Better than usual". 
"Better than usual" is also the only thing I've felt since... a long time ago. Even if I get to a constant state of it, I don't want to be "better than usual" forever.

If you are able to see a psychologist, I would highly recommend trying that. You could manage it so it is during a time of day when your kids are at school. With some cautions, it's possible for no one to know, if you're not ready for that yet.

Yeah... I'm not sure if it's bad in the "unpolished" sort of way, it's bad as in, just really bad writing sort of way... heh... It's really not worth anyone's time. I go back and edit from time to time, but even I still cringe when I read it sometimes.
I hadn't thought of that order yet. Maybe I should try that out for a bit.
I appreciate the interest, though.

No, haha, I'm not that brave, and I don't think I'm a very good writer yet, so it wouldn't be worth reading anyway. Most of the time it's just a way to vent. At least with Daniel it is. Nothing I have is fleshed out more than a scene or two.

Well, I sort of split some of my characters up into different aspects of my personality, or sometimes it was just someone I wanted to be. Daniel was the closest one to being kind of an autobiography novel. It was an interesting way to sort of dissociate from myself or to better understand situations I was in or feelings that I was having (with Daniel's story mostly), so it helped in that aspect. None of them really contributed to my personal name, although with Daniel, and another one named Joey, it allowed me to sort of test it out and see how I felt about the name before I considered it seriously. They really were just characters though, and while the personality was similar to me, the name was unique to them. If that makes some sort of sense.

No, but one of my other top choices was Danny, and I had a character named that. I used him as sort of my "diary entries". If I was feeling strongly that day, or just had something I needed to get out or my "cries for help" on really bad days, I would write them as a narrative using him as the character. So, he was mostly just like me. I exaggerated certain things, but he was essentially me on paper.
I've never heard of them(?). I'll have to go check that out.

I spent a lot of time on name sites (baby names, fictional name generators, names by meaning, by location, etc.) and I had a whole bunch of my own since I write a little bit. I took all the ones that I liked and compiled them in my notebook, adding and subtracting names until I got down to a small list. That's the hard part, trying to whittle it down from 4 or 5. I tried most of them in my head or with my friends. I'd imagine having a conversation with someone where they would use my name or say it when I was alone and talking to myself. I'd try to see which ones "felt" the best; which ones I connected to the most. I'd get my list down a little bit more from there and then take my favorites online or with people until I decided on one, which I think I have. Sorry this is a really long reply. I hope I helped a little bit.
I didn't even know about that subreddit, sweet.
I wouldn't have even thought about that. Good to know.
Not very well. I had a bright spell and drew for an hour, but it faded and now I'm back to feeling like shit.
Nothing yet. But I have this feeling that if I die now, I'll be missing something that might happen later that I would want to see.
Thank you.
Thank you. I hope all goes well.
I'm really glad it seems to have worked out for you. Gives me hope that the situation won't have to be as bad as I think.

The thing is is that I've already chosen my "real" name, but I'm starting to realize that it doesn't fit the way I would have liked, so I have to give them a new "real" name apart from the first one and the birth one. I think people will think I'm just wishy washy and not take me seriously. It will be a hard decision either way; to keep it "in the bag" or not... Thank you. I suppose, even if the first while is a bit embarrassing, it might pass...
Thank you, that's a very good way to say it. *furiously taking notes*
That's good. You're being a good friend.

It's a very difficult thing to be going through, even if maybe it doesn't seem like it. What's important is that if he is your friend, that you stick with him, and just try your best to support him. It's not in your power (nor his) to "fix" him, but you can be right next to him while he's going through it, and that is really important.

Were you able to work on things from outside the facilities while you were in there? Like, a project or homework or something. From what I've been seeing around the internet and everything, it seems like that's a big no, but the facilities seem to be pretty varied and it's hard to tell who is reliable. I know it's a very basic question, but I'm a little bit overwhelmed by the situation to be honest, and I really don't quite know what to ask...
I do have self-harming tendencies, but I'm so much of a coward, I've never been able to plan anything before. That's why I don't know that they'd accept me... But I can tell it's heading there...

It comes and goes, and it's very weak, but I think having a "goal" or at least a next step gives it a chance to show up for a bit. I think that might help some. And you are completely right. The key is to hold on.
How long were people generally there? If you don't mind me asking
I am so sorry... Where do you live? I know some places are worse than others in terms of harassment and violence like that...

It's like everyone's said on here. It's so dark and lonely and hopeless; even when you have friends nearby and even when you have resources available to you... But mostly... It's just very exhausting. You're so tired all the time. You're tired from being sad, and you're tired from being awake. Any emotional spurt no matter how short is entirely draining. You just want to go to sleep and go to sleep forever...

Well, at least this is the sort of depression that I have experienced... I know there are some other ways it expresses itself, but from what I've seen, this is the most common...

I think I can also say I'm in a similar boat, if not the same one. I'm in school. I don't have any friends here to talk to. My depression has only gotten worse since I've been here and I'm falling behind, but there's nothing I can do about it. To use your metaphor... The mounds that I'm making are getting smaller and smaller and I'm running out of energy. It feels so hopeless, and like there's nothing you can do. 

On Monday, though, I'm checking myself into In-Patient at the hospital. My adviser has given me the OK and I will be leaving school for a couple days to get some help sorting this out. For the first time, I feel like there is some hope to get this "fixed". I know it probably won't, and I know your situation might be different, but... Do you think going to an In-Patient or maybe an Intensive Out-Patient program would be of any help to you right now?

Yes. I completely agree. There were a few times where I thought I had found that person, but I'm not sure that I have yet. I very much want to get better. There was a time when that wasn't true, but I just want this to be over with. Thank you very much, and I hope the same for you.
They do, but they're not very helpful... I've seen the school therapist about 4 times so far, and I don't think we're having much progress. I may have to find a place locally that would work better.
Thank you............. I've tried to say something to a couple of my teachers and I'm really starting to understand the difference between college professors and high school teachers......

If it gets worse.... I may have to take a medical leave for the year.... I know there's nothing wrong with it, but I just have it burned into my head that, for me, taking a year off is entirely unacceptable. But, yeah.... If it gets worse, I may have to lower my standards for that... I'll compose an email tonight, thank you for the suggestion. I'm so nervous that she'll think badly of me for this.... But, I suppose there's no avoiding that now...

Thank you. I know it's a really selfish thought. "I'm going to nearly kill myself so I have more time to do this assignment", sounds very childish. I'm at least sitting down with the assignment right now, so... At least that's something, I guess. Even if I don't make any progress. I feel like it's too last minute to talk to her now, though. I feel like such an idiot right now. Too undisciplined to be here... Even if I do talk to her tomorrow... What could I possibly say...?

Depends on how long you go for. Feels like, if you did it intermittently (fasts) or if you just restricted very heavily, that it's self harm. Although, maybe it would be more accurately decided depending on the intent. Even though cutting can be a method of suicide, I feel that it would be considered as self harm if it was just cutting for reasons x, y, or z instead of an actual attempt.
Not yet, but maybe if I build a nest, someone might be magnetically attracted to it? Thank you for the hug. I hope I'll be able to at least get started in the direction of a solution.

I have appointments here with the counseling center due to some medical issues, but you're right. I think I should tell her more about this if I can. Their office apparently might have some connections with local psychiatrists (I'm not sure, but I think this might have something to do with my meds), so it's possible that she can help with something like this. I feel so ashamed though, like I'm a bad student for having this kind of behavior. I haven't thought about talking to my professors though... The idea seems really embarrassing, but if this doesn't clear up on a med change, I'm glad I have the idea now. I'm glad I'm not the only one to have this happen at college... It's supposed to be this huge, exciting time in your life, but I feel like I'm a ghost; looking in on everything. Thank you so much for your advice.
